title: Figures 4-5 (20598): satellite sighting line at 156 degrees and radar line-of-sight map
description: Two Google Earth screen captures. Figure 4 is a satellite view with a drawn sighting line, captioned "(20598) sighting line was judged to be 156 degrees by measurement." Figure 5 shows a radar reflectivity overlay with a dBZ legend (partly redacted under (b)(3)) and star markers labeled 20598 Stephenville and other witness locations, captioned "(20598) Line of sight intersects with one yellow target on the timeline and is very close to an orange target at 01:45:32 (GMT 19th)."
